medical_images.caption: Left shoulder X-ray shows clavicle fracture.
medical_images.description: This is a left shoulder X-ray image. It shows a fracture in the collarbone (clavicle), specifically on the left side. There is also evidence of a nail and plate fixation seen in the image. The rest of the visualized bones appear normal.

FINDINGS SUMMARY:

**Report Type:** CT SCAN, Shoulder AP (X-ray)
**Patient Name:** AYUSH KUMAR
**Age:** 19 years
**Gender:** Male

**Condition/Issue:**
This report is a shoulder X-ray (AP view) taken on [Date]. It was performed to assess the patient's shoulder joint.
**Tests/Procedures Done:**
A shoulder AP X-ray was performed.
**Findings:**
The X-ray shows a slight fracture in the shoulder (clavicle). The fracture appears to be in the middle part of the clavicle (collarbone). The bone appears to be healing and has a few small fragments. The bone appears to be slightly displaced.
**Treatments/Surgeries:**
No surgeries were performed.
**Current Status:**
The patient has a fracture in their right shoulder clavicle. The fracture is healing, but there are signs of displacement.
**Prognosis:**
The prognosis is generally good with proper immobilization and healing, but close follow-up is needed to monitor the healing process and ensure proper alignment.
